meta.anchor: Draw a sprite with its top-left pixel at (anchor.x + ox, anchor.y + oy). A tile sprite anchors at the north (top) corner of the tile diamond at the tile height, a vehicle at its own position.
meta.maskEncoding: mask.png is one channel: 0 outside the company colour; shade s (0 dark to 7 light) is stored as (s + 1) * 32 - 1.
meta.roadBits: road.<grass|town>.<bits>: the half-tile pieces present, from ne, se, sw, nw, joined by -; slope-<ne|se|sw|nw> are the ramps
meta.layers: Parts marked rear are drawn before a vehicle on the tile, front after it.
